adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument, but `refreshOAuthTokens` treats that argument as `userId` and sends it as `calcomUserId` to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (`userId.toString()`). All other updated call sites pass `credential.userId`. Unless `credentialId` is actually the Cal.com user id (not shown in the diff), this is a likely identifier mix-up that would cause the sync endpoint to be called with the wrong `calcomUserId`.
